$comment: The source of sf-inline-editor's interface (core/js/element-manifest.js over core/js/composition/manifest-host.mjs). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/inline-editor (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

input.summary: The text changed while it is edited; sent on the edited element

change.summary: The edit was committed (Enter, or the focus left): the content to save; sent on the edited element

cancel.summary: The edit was put back (Escape): the element shows its HTML from before; sent on the edited element

edit.summary: Starts editing an element of the canvas (SF.Composition.startInlineEdit): options content, nodeId, label, marks, links, messages

default.$comment: The carrier draws nothing: the edited element and the formatting toolbar are drawn by the composition module (core/js/composition/inline-editor.mjs) while an edit lasts.

accessibility.$comment: The carrier is hidden and has no role. While an edit lasts the edited element is role textbox (aria-multiline false) named from the edit's label with the language file's runtime.editing («{label}: редактирование. Enter — сохранить, Escape — отменить.»), and the toolbar is role toolbar with aria-pressed buttons.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-inline-editor for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired. These events are sent on the edited element, which carries no shim: core/js/composition/inline-editor.mjs sends each former name itself, with its former detail.

rows.note: sent by the module after the new name; detail {node_id, content}
rows.summary: Dated alias of sf-inline-editor-input until 2026-12-01: Live normalized content after a change. Dispatched on the edited element; bubbles to document.

rows.note: sent by the module after the new name; detail {node_id, content}
rows.summary: Dated alias of sf-inline-editor-change until 2026-12-01: Editing finished with Enter or focus leaving; the host saves. Dispatched on the edited element; bubbles to document.

rows.note: sent by the module after the new name; detail {node_id}
rows.summary: Dated alias of sf-inline-editor-cancel until 2026-12-01: Editing was cancelled with Escape; the original HTML is restored. Dispatched on the edited element; bubbles to document.

x-summary: Edits a content.heading or content.paragraph in place on the canvas -- strong, em, code and links -- and gives the host the normalised content model, never HTML.
x-renamed: events.sf-inline-edit-input {node_id, content} → input {id, content}: sf-inline-editor-input (x-native false: a CustomEvent input on a contenteditable element would be taken for the browser's own)
events.sf-inline-edit-commit {node_id, content} → change {id, content}: the committed value is a change (vocabulary 1.1.5 §5.1, as sf-theme-change → change); sf-inline-editor-change
lang runtime holds the words of the editor module (MESSAGES of core/js/composition/inline-editor.mjs)
x-decisions: events (vocabulary 1.1.5): input while the text changes, change when the edit is committed (a value changed -- the verb the vocabulary gives sf-theme-change; not save, a write with a revision and a client key the editor does not hold), cancel when it is put back (§5 cancel). Details hold data only in the vocabulary's words: {id, content}, id being the edit's nodeId. input and change are not the browser's events (x-native false): they are sf-inline-editor-input and sf-inline-editor-change, since the edited element is contenteditable and the browser sends its own input there.

the host contract stays: the events are sent on the edited element, bubble to the document, and each is followed by its former name with its former detail -- sf-inline-edit-input, -commit {node_id, content}, -cancel {node_id} -- until 2026-12-01. The element is the host's and carries no shim, so the module sends both itself; aliases.json records the rows for the journal and the sweep. INLINE_EVENTS holds the new names, INLINE_EVENTS_LEGACY the former.
own-verb-words: none -- commit became the vocabulary's change.

edit is the carrier's one action and the host's port (SF.Composition.startInlineEdit): it answers the session {element, commit(), cancel(), value()} as before, not an outcome -- the port stays as the composition editor uses it.

element: the carrier stays the plain element the composition module defines; defineInlineEditor(registry, {base}) extends the class core/js/composition/manifest-host.mjs makes from this component.json (the aliases.json shim, sfWord).
a11y-role: none for the hidden carrier; the edited element is role textbox while an edit lasts, the toolbar role toolbar.
a11y-name: the edited element's name is the edit's label with the language file's runtime.editing (accessibility.name from label).

key-effects: Enter commit, Escape revert, Mod+B, Mod+I, Mod+E toggle:strong, toggle:em, toggle:code, Mod+K open (the link form), Mod+Z step:-1 and Mod+Shift+Z or Mod+Y step:+1 (a step through the edit's history).
words (§11): the language files hold the editor module's words; the module keeps its copy and reads them through the page's language, since SF.Composition.startInlineEdit draws with them.
version 1.1.0: the events renamed behind dated aliases (§4.10).
examples: examples.json -- the carrier alone, and an edit started on a paragraph and on a heading (the carrier has no settings; an edit's options are the action's).

css-variables: five public variables of its sheet, all of an edit in progress: the edited element's outline, the toolbar's fill, radius, gap and padding. Not in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json: its probe measures a component at rest, where none of these parts exist.

version 1.1.2: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

start.description: SF.Composition.startInlineEdit(element, {content, nodeId, label, marks, links, messages}) or element.edit(target, options) returns {element, commit(), cancel(), value()}. Before the component is loaded startInlineEdit throws inline_editor_not_loaded. Also exposed as SF.InlineEditor {INLINE_EVENTS, readInlineDom, renderInlineDom, startInlineEdit, textOffset}.

links.description: http, https, mailto, tel, relative and fragment links only; protocol-relative and backslash addresses are refused, as in Document validation.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use the inline editor for text of content.heading and content.paragraph on an editor page. Save the committed content through the host Property contract, validate the Document and re-render.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not save HTML; events carry the content model
Do not offer lists; the content model has none
Do not call startInlineEdit before sf-inline-editor is defined

accessibility.focus: The sf-inline-editor carrier is hidden and has no role. While editing, the edited element becomes a labelled role=textbox with a visible outline; the formatting toolbar has aria-pressed states and aria-keyshortcuts. Enter commits, Escape cancels, focus leaving commits; IME composition is never interrupted.

sf-inline-edit-input.summary: Dated alias of sf-inline-editor-input until 2026-12-01: Live normalized content after a change. Dispatched on the edited element; bubbles to document.

sf-inline-edit-commit.summary: Dated alias of sf-inline-editor-change until 2026-12-01: Editing finished with Enter or focus leaving; the host saves. Dispatched on the edited element; bubbles to document.

sf-inline-edit-cancel.summary: Dated alias of sf-inline-editor-cancel until 2026-12-01: Editing was cancelled with Escape; the original HTML is restored. Dispatched on the edited element; bubbles to document.
